name: Foam Roller Body Saw
steps: Place a foam roller across the floor and take a plank position with your forearms on the roller and toes planted.
Brace your abdomen and keep your head, hips and heels in line.
Press your forearms forward to roll them slightly away from your toes while keeping your hips level.
Draw the roller back until your elbows are beneath your shoulders.
tips: Keep the rolling distance short enough to prevent your lower back from sagging.
Press both forearms evenly into the roller to keep it traveling straight.
